introHtml: Throws canopy tents are lightweight, portable pop-up tents designed for quick setup and maximum branding impact. Unlike traditional frame tents, throws feature a one-piece canopy that slips over a standard frame, making them ideal for trade shows, outdoor festivals, and corporate events where you need a professional presence without heavy hardware. The full-color dye-sublimation printing on these tents produces vibrant, edge-to-edge graphics that resist fading and peeling. Choose from 5' or 10' square sizes to fit your booth space and budget.
